card.name: The start of co-administration
card.fires_on: The piece "co" at the start of words like coadministration, co-administered and co-morbid, especially after "avoid" or "do not" in drug interaction text.

modes.label: The warning against co-administration
modes.description: "co" follows avoid or do not, before administration of a named drug.
modes.example: Avoid<< co>>administration of LENVIMA with medicinal products

modes.label: Other co- words
modes.description: "co" begins co-morbid, co-administered or coeliac in a list or sentence.
modes.example: Migraines tied to<< co>>eliac disease Hormonal changes trigger

card.plain: It marks the start of the word co-administration, often in warnings about giving two drugs together.

Do not<< co>>administer aliskiren with aml
